title: PeopleSoft Studio's Page and Field Configurator writer replays PIA's captured saves row for row
statement: Planned from each capture's before-state, the writer's statements reproduce every configuration row, mapping row (instance ids drawn as the related-content API draws them), tombstone, language row, tracking row and counter PIA wrote in pfc01-configure and pfc02-remove.

observations.observation: src/test/pfcWriter.test.ts: all tests pass, including the pfc01 and pfc02 replays.

testResults.name: a first configuration writes the configuration rows PIA wrote [pfc01]
a first configuration maps its content references as PIA did [pfc01]
a re-save replaces the configuration rows and the type's mapping as PIA did [pfc02]
an inactive configuration removes the type's mapping, and the service when nothing is left
the services a save deletes follow DeleteUtilityServiceMapping
configuration checks: keys, sequences, statuses; the page's warnings
